copy.curiosityHook: When an ordinary convoy run erupts into a violent rebel ambush, how will an untested enlistee's martial arts skills reshape the fight?
copy.description: Given a choice between prison and enlistment, a martial-arts-trained drifter joins an Army base in the Philippines. When rebels ambush his weapons convoy and target the colonel's daughter, he is forced into action.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, kinetic, and light, offering brisk 95-minute action that demands engaged attention without emotional strain.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Sam Firstenberg, this 1985 adventure delivers swift combat choreography and straightforward heroic thrills, making it ideal for high-energy viewing with friends.

allowedMaterial: Joe Armstrong's background as an orphaned drifter
Choice between prison and army enlistment
Posting to an American Army base in the Philippines
Convoy ambush by rebels trying to steal weapons
Attempted kidnapping of the base colonel's daughter
excludedMaterial: Identity of the ninja antagonists or leaders
Outcome of the convoy ambush and kidnapping attempt
